articles.title: Ripple’s bank-lending system moves closer to launch on the XRP Ledger
articles.snippet: Lending support among the ledger’s 35 validators has climbed from 19 to 22 since mid-October, and no public tracker shows which validators switched.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: The GENIUS Act’s guarantees don’t cover DeFi lending
articles.snippet: Institutions weighing DeFi lending tend to ask which markets are safest. Mike Hathaway and Joseph Quintilian of Ajna argue the better question is who can change a loan’s terms after the money is lent, and why a fully backed stablecoin offers no protection against a token vote or a faulty price feed.

articles.title: Binance CSO unwittingly foreshadowed $6.3B hack tactic months before attack
articles.snippet: In a July interview, Binance chief security officer Jimmy Su explained how fake coding assessments could compromise employee devices, a tactic later used in the exchange’s record-breaking hack.

articles.title: Suiet wallet to shut down in latest exit from Sui ecosystem
articles.snippet: The self-custodial wallet will keep its API services running through Nov. 14. Sui’s DeFi total value locked has fallen more than 22% over the past month.

articles.title: Paraguay bank collapse shows stablecoins can offer a lifeline... of sorts
articles.snippet: Ueno’s collapse exposed the fragility of digital banking in Paraguay, as customers scrambled for access to their money and stablecoins offered a lifeline.
